youtube_title: Jesus... My Friend Borrowed Money Again | Matthew 5:37 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

Her friend keeps borrowing money and she cannot bring herself to say no even though it weighs on her.

She: Jesus... my friend asked to borrow money again. Why can't I say no? 💸
She: I checked my balance twice before sending it. He never mentioned the last one.
Jesus: You gave him the money easily and the honesty never.
She: Isn't refusing him unkind? He is struggling too.
Jesus: A yes you resent helps no one. A true no leaves the friendship alive.

“Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.”
Matthew 5:37 (BSB)

Generosity with a boundary is still generosity.

💬 How do you say no to a friend who borrows? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
